An evolving record of work, thoughts and questions as I work through the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge.
In the spirit of William Zinsser's excellent *Writing to Learn*[^writing-to-learn] I am writing this to clarify my own thoughts and share useful information I find along the way.

I hope you enjoy the read.

[^writing-to-learn]: William Zinsser, [*Writing to Learn*](https://www.harpercollins.com/products/writing-to-learn-william-zinsser) (1988), makes the case that writing about a subject is one of the best ways to understand it.
